?Court No. - 50
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 103 of 2023

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This Application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to direct the court below to hear and decide the Case No. 1304 of 2021 (State vs. Harpreet Singh and others) in Case Crime no. 83 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 377 IPC, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Aligarh pending before A.C.J.M., court no. 5, Aligarh expeditiously within stipulated time.

entities.text: Case No. 1304 of 2021 (State vs. Harpreet Singh and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant states that copy of the ordersheet is filed which reveals that cognizance was taken in the case on 20.9.2021; accused were summoned and baring one accused,
other had appeared; bailable warrant has been issued, hence, a direction may be issued to the court below to the decide the same expeditiously.

It is directed that court below shall make all endeavour to decide this case expeditiously in accordance with law, without permitting undue adjournments to either side, if there is no legal impediment.
